dataset: Canadian Drought Monitor, monthly areas of drought (D0-D4), April-September 2003-2026
publisher: Agriculture and Agri-Food Canada, National Agroclimate Information Service
format: Zipped ESRI shapefiles, one per class (CDM_YYMM_Dn_LR.shp)
crs: EPSG:3857 (most years) or AAFC Albers equal-area (some years); reprojected to EPSG:3979
spatial_coverage: Canada except Nunavut and the Arctic Archipelago (per product specification)
validation_notes: Not published: Apr-Sep 2002 (series starts Nov 2002) and Aug 2003 (not in directory listing). All zips pass unzip -t. Product spec says the CDM covers Canada except Nunavut and the Arctic Archipelago; see drought_coverage_check.csv for how often northern areas show any dryness by year.

dataset: ECCC Lightning Density Data (Canadian Lightning Detection Network, 2.5 km, 10-minute)
publisher: Environment and Climate Change Canada, Meteorological Service of Canada
temporal_coverage: Datamart dated folders only back to 2026-09-22 (about 30 days); WMS time dimension last 3 hours (checked 2026-10-21)
validation_notes: NOT USED: no open archive covering the 2026 fire season or earlier years. Raw CLDN flash data are not open. Lightning-caused fire counts (agency cause codes) used instead.
